While Telstar earned numerous corner kicks, Jeff Hardeveld was unable to connect with his teammates in the box. The floodgates opened quickly thereafter: Tyrese Noslin doubled the advantage just two minutes later following a clever assist from Patrick Brouwer . Following a VAR review, Luka Kulenovic was shown a straight red card in the 92nd minute for a reckless challenge on Nils Rossen , effectively ending any hopes of a late comeback and cementing the 3-0 scoreline.
